final_topology.title: Government Data Center Topology
final_topology.description: A secure and compliant data center design with isolated zones for public services, development, and production systems.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a DMZ for public-facing services, isolated zones for development and production, and a disaster recovery site. All network activity is logged for compliance.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management Zone' and 'Asset Management System' with links to various zones and servers, indicating the presence of an asset management system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation Zone' and 'Data Flow Documentation System' with links to various zones and servers, indicating the presence of data flow documentation.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for DMZ, Development, Production, and Disaster Recovery, indicating proper segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' node in the DMZ and links to other zones, indicating the presence of a firewall.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' node in the Management Zone with links to the Identity Server and Firewall, indicating the presence of trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Node' in the Management Zone with links to the Firewall, indicating the presence of MFA for remote access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Node' in the Management Zone with links to the Firewall, indicating the presence of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy/URL Filter' node in the Management Zone with links to the Firewall, indicating the presence of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for DMZ, Development, Production, Disaster Recovery, and Management, indicating a well-segmented and secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Management Zone' with nodes for identity management, DNS, and other security services, indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' and 'MFA/Identity Node' in the Management Zone with links to the Firewall, indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Service' node in the Remote Access Zone with links to the Firewall and Identity Server, indicating the presence of a VPN and connection to AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Dedicated Admin Workstation' in the Management Zone with links to the Firewall, indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' node in the Security Zone with links to the SIEM, indicating the presence of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes links between zones (DMZ to Development, Development to Production, etc.) with firewalls and other security nodes, indicating traffic filtering between segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control System' in the Remote Access Control Zone with links to the Firewall and Identity Server, indicating the presence of access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Log Collection System' in the Management Zone with links to routers, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' node in the Security Zone with links to the SIEM, indicating the presence of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X/NAC Node' in the Management Zone with links to the Firewall, indicating the presence of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' node in the Management Zone with links to the Firewall, indicating the presence of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for Development and Production, indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Node' and 'Penetration Testing Management System' in the External Testing Zone with links to the Firewall and other nodes, indicating the presence of penetration testing capabilities.
